text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a single error taxonomy + dashboard requirements for the new SLO matrix. Focus: timeouts, 5xx, OOM, degraded-mode/fallback counts. Can we agree on labels and ownership? @oliver @tess @ryan

oliver: SG. From runtime POV we can emit metrics: inference_error{type="timeout|oom|5xx", code="504|500", model="gpt-x" , route="/v1/chat", tier="hosted|dedicated|private"} count, and inference_latency_ms histogram. Is that enough?

tess: Need separate metric for fallback emitted by routing layer: fallback_event{from_model="gpt-x", to_model="gpt-small-q", reason="quota|oom|deg_mode"} -> counts and sample rate. Also include request_id label for traces only.

ryan: Important: degraded_mode entry/exit counts. Suggest degraded_mode{component="router|runtime|kvcache", state="enter|exit", cause="oom|latency|kvcache_busy"}. We'll want MTTR math on dashboard.

oliver: Question: request_id label cardinality is huge; we shouldn't put high-cardinality labels on Prom counters. Maybe include request_sampled="true|false" for a lightweight hint and keep request_id in traces only.

tess: Agree. We'll use trace_id in traces. For dashboards we need to aggregate by route/model/tier and show top N causes. For "top causes" we can emit cause as label but limit possible values.

maya: Ownership proposal: runtime -> inference_error + degraded_mode signals; routing -> fallback_event; obs -> dashboards + alerts. Can we get a short schema doc we can embed in the console?

oliver: I'll add metric names + label enums to INFRA repo. Example snippet:
```
# prometheus metrics (examples)
inference_error_total{type="timeout",code="504",model="redwood-1",route="/v1/chat",tier="hosted"} 1
fallback_event_total{from_model="redwood-1",to_model="redwood-1-quant",reason="oom",sampled="false"} 1
degraded_mode_total{component="runtime",state="enter",cause="kvcache_busy"} 1
```

tess: Dashboard requirements: per-route error rate, per-model p95 latency, fallback ratio (fallback_event_total / requests_total), degraded-mode MTTR, and a rollout widget showing canary vs baseline error delta. Need top-causes table with percentage breakdown.

ryan: Also need backfill plan for historical metrics missing labels — suggest adding a migration mapping and a backfill script that maps old metric names to new schema with a "migration" label for tracking.

maya: UX ask: console rollout page should surface fallback_rate and fallback_count with hoverable breakdown by reason. Also show applied route_policy_id on the widget. Can runtime include route_policy_id label?

oliver: route_policy_id OK but ensure it's low-cardinality (short id). We'll emit route_policy="rp_<short>". No raw JSON blobs as labels.

tess: Alerts: error rate spike OR fallback_ratio > 5% sustained over 5m => page oncall. Add SLO burn-rate alerts per service. We should also add a sparse-sampling trace link in the alert to jump to traces.

sre-bot: Incident detected: high fallback ratio on /v1/embeddings at 1918239000. Auto-notifying #eng-oncall.

maya: thanks. Can we have owners add PRs by EOD tomorrow? I'll track in the infra board (infra/metrics). Short follow-ups ok here.

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/402 (metric names + enums).

tess: Dashboard draft in grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/6b3/errors-slo-matrix (WIP panels for fallback ratio & top causes).

ryan: I'll add degraded_mode counters to runtime today and add a small export shim so legacy consumers don't break.

maya: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
